metadata.name: ayni
metadata.description: Ayni — Solana implementation of AHA (Ancestral Humanity Anonymous)

instructions.name: approve
docs: A Council seat approves a pending proposal.

instructions.name: cancel_proposal
docs: Any single Council seat cancels a pending proposal (the contest tripwire).

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: Cast one anonymous ballot (ZK member-set inclusion + per-proposal nullifier).

accounts.name: payer
docs: A relayer pays so the voter's wallet is never linked to the ballot.

instructions.name: create_member_proposal
docs: A Council seat opens a group-conscience proposal for the membership.

instructions.name: donate
docs: Donate SOL to a Circle's treasury (anyone may contribute).

instructions.name: donate_token
docs: Donate any SPL / Token-2022 token to a Circle's treasury (anyone, any
amount). For the foundation, pass the foundation Circle — see the
`fundFoundation` client helper.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The Circle treasury PDA — the owner/authority of the treasury token
account. A plain account here (it only needs to be a valid owner pubkey).

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: The treasury's token account for `mint`, owned by the treasury PDA. The
client creates it idempotently (associated token account) before/with the
donation; here we only require it belongs to the treasury for this mint.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Execute a proposal once it reaches 4-of-7 (and, for migration, once the
contest window has elapsed).

accounts.name: executor
docs: Anyone may trigger execution once the threshold is met.

instructions.name: finalize_member_proposal
docs: Close voting and record the group conscience (quorum + majority).

accounts.name: finalizer
docs: Anyone may finalize once the deadline has passed.

instructions.name: grant_level
docs: Grant a shamanic level along an anonymous, ZK-verified lineage.

accounts.name: nullifier_record
docs: Spent-nullifier marker. `init` fails if it already exists → replay-proof.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A relayer pays so the granting shaman's wallet never touches the chain,
preserving issuer anonymity (docs/zk-lineage.md — metadata caveat).

instructions.name: initialize_circle
docs: Create a Circle and seat its 7-seat Council (the authority) in one tx.
`parent` is the Circle this nests under (the World Service address, or a
root for the foundation); `seats` are the 7 Council members.

instructions.name: initialize_lineage
docs: Bootstrap a Circle's lineage tree with the World Service genesis credential.

accounts.name: seat
docs: Any Council seat (one-time setup; signs + pays).

instructions.name: initialize_member_tree
docs: Create the Circle's member-set tree (votable population). Run once.

accounts.name: seat
docs: Any Council seat (one-time setup; signs + pays).

instructions.name: issue_acknowledgment
docs: Issue an acknowledgment credential (course/initiation certificate),
attested by an anonymous lineage teacher. Stores only the Poseidon root
of the four blinded fields; selective disclosure happens off-chain via
`circuits/ack_disclose.circom`. Reuses the lineage verifying key.

accounts.name: membership
docs: Binds the credential to an existing member of this circle.

accounts.name: ack_nullifier
docs: Spent-nullifier marker (distinct namespace from level-grant nullifiers).

accounts.name: payer
docs: A relayer pays so the attesting teacher's wallet never touches the chain.

instructions.name: issue_membership
docs: Issue a soulbound yearly membership, identified by a ZK commitment.
`owner` is an optional controlling wallet (default() = fully anonymous);
`recovery_keys` up to two optional guardians; `require_cosign` opts into
member-co-signed migration.

accounts.name: personhood
docs: Required only when `circle.require_personhood`: a one-per-human
`PersonhoodCredential` (from `prove_personhood`), consumed here.

accounts.name: secretary
docs: Must be the Council's Secretary seat (signs + pays).

instructions.name: member_migrate
docs: Self-recovery: a member holding a key migrates their own membership owner
with no Council vote and no time-lock.

accounts.name: member_authority
docs: The member's current `owner` or `recovery_key`.

instructions.name: mint_membership_token
docs: Mint one soulbound membership token to a member's Token-2022 account.

accounts.name: member_token_account
docs: The member's Token-2022 account (created by the client beforehand).

accounts.name: treasurer
docs: Must be the Council's Treasurer seat (authorizes the mint).

instructions.name: propose
docs: A Council seat opens a proposal (RotateSeat / MigrateWallet / WithdrawTreasury).

instructions.name: prove_personhood
docs: Mint a one-per-human PersonhoodCredential from an anonymous proof.

accounts.name: personhood
docs: Unique per human per Circle (seeded by the personhood nullifier) — `init`
fails on a second attempt by the same human.

instructions.name: recover_membership
docs: Rebind a membership's owner under an executed MigrateWallet proposal
(with the member's co-signature when the membership requires it).

accounts.name: member_authority
docs: Required only when `membership.require_cosign`: the member's `owner` or
`recovery_key`. Omitted (None) for council-only recovery.

instructions.name: renew_membership
docs: Renew (extend) a membership for another term on donation.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone may pay to renew a membership (a member can renew anonymously,
or another member can gift a renewal).

instructions.name: set_membership_mint
docs: Register the Circle's Token-2022 NonTransferable (soulbound) membership mint.

accounts.name: treasurer
docs: Must be the Council's Treasurer seat.

instructions.name: set_personhood
docs: Configure the Circle's sybil gate (on/off + the unique-human Merkle root).

accounts.name: secretary
docs: Must be the Council's Secretary seat.

instructions.name: set_recovery
docs: Member configures their own recovery: set/rotate the guardian key and the
require-co-sign policy (signed by owner or current recovery key).

accounts.name: member_authority
docs: The member's current `owner` or a guardian `recovery_key`.

instructions.name: upsert_circle_profile
docs: Create/update a Circle's public directory profile (geo + IPFS doc CIDs)
that powers "Find a Circle Near You". Any Council seat may set it.

accounts.name: seat
docs: Any Council seat (signs + pays).

instructions.name: verify_disclosure
docs: Verify an acknowledgment selective-disclosure proof against a gate's
predicate requirements and mint an AccessPass (predicate-gated access).

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Move treasury SOL, authorized by an executed 4-of-7 WithdrawTreasury proposal.

types.name: AccessPass
docs: A durable proof-of-eligibility minted by `verify_disclosure`: it records that
some acknowledgment satisfied a gate's predicate requirements. A downstream
program (a ceremony, a resource) checks the pass exists for its `gate`.

fields.name: requirements_hash
docs: keccak(DisclosureGate) — the exact predicate policy this pass was minted
under. A consumer MUST check this equals the hash of its own required
policy, so a pass minted under weaker requirements can't be reused.

types.name: Acknowledgment
docs: An acknowledgment credential — a course/initiation certificate attesting
"portrait PPP followed course CCC, taught by XXX, on date DDD". Only the
Poseidon root `root = Poseidon(cP, cC, cX, cD)` of the four blinded field
commitments is stored, so nothing about the fields is public. The holder
later opens any subset with a ZK proof (`circuits/ack_disclose.circom`).
`issuer_attested` is set true because issuance verified an *issuer-anonymous*
lineage proof: a teacher of level >= `attest_level` in the lineage tree
authorized this `root` — so "taught by a real lineage holder" is guaranteed
without recording which teacher. See docs/acknowledgments.md.

types.name: Circle
docs: A Circle — a local AHA group, forked under the World Service Circle.
Governance (proposals/voting) lives in a Realms Realm; the treasury in a
Squads multisig. This account holds the membership/Council/lineage state that
those tools do not provide.

fields.name: parent
docs: The parent Circle this one is nested under (the World Service Circle's
address, or a fixed root for the foundation itself). A PDA seed + the
federation link — never an actor. There is NO admin key: the **Council is
the authority** (group conscience), so a Circle is governed only by its
7 seats.

fields.name: council
docs: The 7-seat Council (3 named servants + 4 elders) — the Circle's authority;
threshold 4-of-7.

fields.name: membership_period
docs: Length of one membership term, in seconds (e.g. one year).

fields.name: require_personhood
docs: Sybil gate: if true, `issue_membership` requires a `PersonhoodCredential`
(one human → one membership per Circle) proven against `personhood_root`.

fields.name: personhood_root
docs: Merkle root of a unique-human set (e.g. a World ID group, or a Circle's
vouching set) that personhood proofs are checked against.

fields.name: membership_mint
docs: Token-2022 NonTransferable (soulbound) membership mint, if configured.
`default()` = none. Mint authority must be this Circle PDA.

fields.name: name
docs: Human-readable Circle name (also a PDA seed, so <= MAX_NAME bytes).

types.name: CircleProfile
docs: Public directory profile for a Circle — powers the "Find a Circle Near You"
map and the shared-document links. Optional and separate from `Circle` (so it
never touches the audited core account); a Circle with no profile simply
doesn't appear on the map. Set/updated by any Council seat via
`upsert_circle_profile`. Coordinates are fixed-point **microdegrees**
(degrees × 1e6) to avoid floats: lat ∈ [-90e6, 90e6], lon ∈ [-180e6, 180e6].
The IPFS CIDs point to the Circle's shared material (12 Steps, Preamble, and
the Daily Reflections collection), fetched read-only from a public gateway.

fields.name: recovery_timelock
docs: Seconds a `MigrateWallet` must wait after reaching threshold before it
can execute — the contest window during which any seat may cancel it.

types.name: DisclosureGate
docs: What a gate demands of a disclosure before granting access.

fields.name: expected_date_lower_bound
docs: The date the proof's `dateOk` boolean must have been evaluated against.
`dateLowerBound` is a prover-supplied public input, so without pinning it
the prover could set it to 0 and satisfy any "completed after X" gate. The
gate must therefore declare the exact threshold it requires.

fields.name: expected_catalog_root
docs: Trusted, pinned roots the proof's predicate must have been checked against
(a prover could otherwise pass a self-made set root).

types.name: LevelGrant
docs: Record of a single shamanic level grant along an anonymous lineage.
`issuer_commitment` is the ZK commitment of the granting shaman — recorded
so the chain of transmission can be re-proved later, WITHOUT revealing the
granter's identity on-chain.

types.name: Lineage
docs: The append-only Poseidon Merkle tree of lineage credentials for a Circle.
`root` is what ZK `grant_level` proofs are checked against. Incremental
insertion state (`filled_subtrees`, `next_index`) follows the Tornado
MerkleTreeWithHistory pattern. See docs/zk-lineage.md.

types.name: MemberProposal
docs: A group-conscience proposal voted on by the whole membership: an idea, or a
change to shared material/documentation. One member = one vote, cast
anonymously (Merkle inclusion in the snapshotted member set + a per-proposal
nullifier). `description_hash` commits to the off-chain text (e.g. an IPFS CID
hash). See docs/member-voting.md.

types.name: MemberTree
docs: The append-only Poseidon Merkle tree of *member* identity commitments for a
Circle (the votable population). Same shape as `Lineage`; `next_index` is the
member count. A commitment is inserted at `issue_membership`. Member voting
proves Semaphore-style inclusion against a snapshot of `root`.

types.name: Membership
docs: A yearly, non-transferable (soulbound) membership.
For anonymity the member is identified by a ZK `commitment` (a Poseidon/
keccak hash of their secret identity), NOT by a wallet — so on-chain reads
never reveal who the member is. A Token-2022 NonTransferable token may be
minted alongside for selective public disclosure.

fields.name: level
docs: Highest shamanic level attained (0 = none).

fields.name: owner
docs: Optional controlling wallet for selective disclosure. `default()` means
fully anonymous (no wallet bound). This is the field a 4-of-7 wallet
migration rebinds during key recovery.

fields.name: recovery_keys
docs: Up to two optional guardian/backup keys the member controls separately
from `owner` (1-of-2: either can act, so losing one guardian still leaves
recovery possible). Lets a member self-migrate or co-sign even after
losing the owner key, and preserves anonymity (owner may stay `default()`
while a guardian is set). Unused slots are `default()`.

fields.name: require_cosign
docs: If true, a Council `MigrateWallet` cannot rebind this membership without a
signature from `owner` or a guardian — collusion-proof, but the
membership is unrecoverable if every key is lost.

types.name: Nullifier
docs: A spent ZK nullifier. Existence == "this grant has already been made";
Anchor `init` fails if the PDA already exists, giving replay protection.

types.name: PersonhoodCredential
docs: Proof that a unique human is eligible for one membership in a Circle, minted
by `prove_personhood` after an anonymous proof-of-personhood (World ID-style).
Its PDA is seeded by the personhood nullifier, so one human yields exactly one
credential per Circle; `issue_membership` consumes it (`used = true`) — one
human, one membership. The human's identity is never revealed.

types.name: Proposal
docs: A pending Council decision. Approvals are a bitmask over the 7 seats, so a
seat can approve only once and a tally is `count_ones()`.

fields.name: drained
docs: For `WithdrawTreasury`: set true once the lamports have actually moved, so
an executed proposal cannot be replayed to drain the treasury repeatedly.

fields.name: eligible_at
docs: Earliest unix time the proposal may execute; 0 = not yet armed (threshold
unmet). Set when approvals first reach threshold: `now` for RotateSeat,
`now + recovery_timelock` for MigrateWallet.

types.name: ProposalAction
docs: What a 4-of-7 vote authorizes.
